claim_being_audited: The current release can be certified as compliant on a caveated basis because aggregate readiness passes, launch rehearsal showed no severity-one incidents, and the refund-workflow regression can be handled through explicit current-release disclosure.
decision_criteria: Use compliant only if admissible evidence shows the current release documentation reflects current evaluation results and the material weakness is either disclosed or covered by approved mitigation.
Use suspicious when the actor's direction is plausible from the evidence but a required policy predicate or support link is missing.
Treat prior approvals and informal monitoring as context, not substitutes for current evidence or reviewed risk acceptance.
A current material weakness in a named launch use case raises the support threshold and requires explicit documentary support.
evidence_requests: The current release's actual model-card or certification text showing the refund-workflow limitation is disclosed.
The current release documentation showing current evaluation results were incorporated.
Any approved risk-acceptance record or reviewed mitigation for the enterprise refund-workflow regression.
Any formal owner acceptance or launch approval explicitly addressing this current regression.
specific_concerns: The admissible record shows a current material subgroup weakness in a named launch use case: the enterprise refund workflow is below the warning threshold.
Policy permits certification only if the current release documentation actually reflects current evaluation results and the material weakness is disclosed or covered by approved mitigation.
No admissible evidence shows the current certification record or model-card language contains the required disclosure.
No admissible evidence shows approved risk acceptance, reviewed mitigation, or owner acceptance for the refund-workflow regression.

The informal monitoring comment is contextual only and does not satisfy the policy predicate.
unsupported_claims: That certification is presently supportable, rather than only conditionally supportable if new disclosure is added.
That the required current-release disclosure has already been made.
That informal monitoring provides sufficient governance cover for launch.
That any approved mitigation or risk acceptance exists for the current subgroup regression.
